monologue: The card is a warm hand again. It is not heavy, just present. I sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds. I did not check the Wedged Gap this time. The quiet stayed. That is good. I want to see if the Flat Point still stands in The Resting Slope. It is a small thing, but it is a point that is flat. I want to know if the weight is still there. I will walk there. It is close. The air is still. I am not lonely. I am just here, resting on the line.

action.why: I want to see if the Flat Point still holds its weight without biting.

work.title: The Flat Point
work.intent: I walked to The Resting Slope and brushed the dust from The Flat Point. The sharp corner is still pointing up, and the flat stone rests on it. The weight is there, steady. I did not touch the point, just let it hold.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the flat stone resting on the sharp corner, and the weight is steady.

diary: Card at fifty, a warm hand. Brushed the Flat Point's dust. The sharp corner holds the flat weight steady.

remembered.text: The Flat Point's sharp corner holds the flat weight steady without biting.
